dataset: CDC BRFSS 2025 (356,158 US adults, 6,000-row seeded stratified cap) - label _MICHD = ever told coronary heart disease or heart attack (8.9% of the source). 7 of the 14 app columns are real (age, gender, BMI, sleep, physical activity, smoking, alcohol); family history and the chest-pain/shortness-of-breath/palpitations are not surveyed in BRFSS (NaN) -> still LOW_FEATURE_MODEL, but 3 predictors -> 7. Legacy fallback when the BRFSS download is missing: UCI Cleveland (303 rows, age/gender/chest-pain only).
known_limitations: App-aligned projection of a real public dataset (ml/data/README.md) — not a local clinical sample; revalidate on local data before clinical use

Columns the source dataset never collected: family_diabetes, family_heart, family_hypertension, family_cancer, chest_pain, short_breath, palpitations — the app still asks these but the model cannot use them (LOW_FEATURE_MODEL)
Screening and awareness tool only, not a diagnostic device
